item.title: [158] NVIDIA Allegedly Engineered Scarcity By Funding AI Startups To Buy Its GPUs
item.description:
Nvidia and AI scandal is the shit that keeps on shitting

>Following the departure of now-former NVIDIA CEO, Jensen Huang, a new report by The Wall Street Journal (via Wccftech) has emerged alleging that NVIDIA artificially inflated the ongoing GPU and memory shortage by investing in AI startups that would go on to buy NVIDIA GPUs and build data centers. The reason behind this was to maintain the perception of ongoing high demand and to move an oversupply of semiconductors from TSMC.

>
The WSJ report cites an August meeting between Huang and his senior finance team, including NVIDIA's CFO and acting CEO, Colette Kress, during which Kress pushed for a reduction in circular financing agreements, in response to which Huang allegedly lay into Kress, calling her a "deer in the headlights," after she had pushed to scale back NVIDIA's $250 billion deal with OpenAI. Jensen's push for further investment into small-scale cloud providers was seemingly in response to the changing tide that saw AI hyperscalers move away from off-the-shelf components in favor of custom solutions.

>The situation described in the report saw NVIDIA on the hook for an "avalanche" of GPUs from TSMC, for which it would have no immediate buyers. Part of the issue highlighted by Kress was also that these small-scale cloud providers NVIDIA was investing in could not afford to buy NVIDIA GPUs, meaning they, too, could be a financial dead end.

item.title: [ 40] Remember when you had to install games? Find and run install.exe. Click next
item.description:
Remember when you had to install games?

Find and run install.exe. Click next, browse for a folder, click next, uncheck "add icon to desktop", click next, check "Install DirectX", click next, wait for the progress bar, change disc, wait, "game has been installed successfully", finally click finished. Click the Start button and find the game folder and click the game icon.

And to think some of you still want that and buy games on GOG.

item.title: [ 36] Breaking News: FAA Orders Nationwide Ground Stop for All Airports
item.description:
Thread theme: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yLHCm7e0uBg

> https://abcnews.com/US/nationwide-ground-stop-ordered-airports-faa/story?id=138121848

The Federal Aviation Administration ordered a nationwide ground stop Friday for all airports due to a communication issue affecting air traffic control.

The agency's alert said the stop was "due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety."

Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said in an X statement a short while later that the stop was "due a communication issue impacting all Air Route Traffic Control Centers."

"FAA technicians are investigating the issue," he said in an X post.

This is the second time since Sept. 11, 2001, that the FAA has ordered a nationwide ground stop. The last time was in 2023, when the FAA NOTAM system went down and pilots could not get their pre-departure paperwork.

Air Route Traffic Control Centers are responsible for all flights above 18,000 feet. There are 22 of those centers in the U.S.

Pilots who are in the air have flight plans and are prepared to continue with their flight path in case of such an emergency, according to ABC News contributor John Nance.

"All pilots in that environment know what to do," Nance told ABC News on Friday.

"It is a matter of predictability. Air Traffic Control knows that airplane is going to come out of the sky at some point of time looking for a pathway," he later added.

Earlier in the afternoon, the FAA issued a ground stop at both Chicago's O'Hare and Midway airports due to equipment outage.

>This is a developing story. Please check back for updates.

https://apnews.com/article/scott-colom-mississippi-senate-midterms-56c18f292a734443992f9466c3b0f346

JACKSON, Miss. (AP) — Democratic nominee Scott Colom defeated Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith on Wednesday in Mississippi’s closely contested U.S. Senate race after a prolonged ballot counting process, giving the state its first Black U.S. senator since post-Civil War Reconstruction.

Colom’s narrow victory is a seismic shift in Mississippi, which has been controlled mostly by white conservatives for generations despite having the largest share of Black residents of any U.S. state. The outcome adds to a decisive midterm rebuke of President Donald Trump, whose party suffered defeats in several Republican-controlled states, and it will bolster some Democrats’ argument that their future runs through the American South.

The Associated Press called the contest Wednesday in Colom’s favor after local elections officials spent several days processing absentee and provisional ballots, called affidavit ballots in Mississippi.

“While this is not the outcome we worked for or hoped for, I respect the decision of Mississippi voters,” Hyde-Smith, 67, said in a two-minute concession speech posted online. “I want to congratulate Scott Colom and wish him well as he takes on the tremendous responsibility of representing our great state.”

A spokesman for the senator said she called Colom to congratulate him and concede before the video was shared publicly.

Colom scheduled a victory celebration with supporters Wednesday night in Jackson.

Colom, a 43-year-old local prosecutor, capitalized on the large Black population, discontent with the economy and Hyde-Smith’s missteps as she sought a second full term.

item.title: [ 37] China Crushed By Trump's Tariffs!
item.description:
China’s trade surplus tops $1 trillion as exports surge

https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/china-says-2026-trade-surplus-surpassed-1-tn-in-october-229211

China’s trade surplus reached $1.04 trillion in the first 10 months of 2026 as global investment in artificial intelligence infrastructure supported exports of high-tech products and helped offset weak domestic demand.

Exports rose 35.2 percent year-on-year in U.S. dollar terms in October, customs data showed on Nov. 10. Growth eased from September’s 36.3 percent but exceeded the 33.5 percent forecast in a Reuters poll.

Imports climbed 41.6 percent, accelerating from 31 percent in September and beating expectations of a 32 percent rise. The monthly trade surplus narrowed to $105.3 billion from $133.5 billion.

China passed the $1 trillion surplus threshold for a second consecutive year, reaching it a month earlier than in 2025 and putting it on course to exceed last year’s record of nearly $1.2 trillion.

The export gains have supported an economy facing subdued consumption and a prolonged property downturn that has weakened household wealth and confidence.

The imbalance is also evident in the car market. Passenger vehicle exports rose 68.2 percent year-on-year in October, while domestic sales fell 27.3 percent, according to the China Passenger Car Association.

Weak demand at home has pushed automakers to seek more buyers overseas.

The growing surplus could increase pressure for further trade restrictions, particularly in the European Union.

Beijing and Brussels have agreed to limit Chinese hybrid-vehicle exports to the bloc, but the measures have yet to take effect. Manufacturers are expected to bring shipments forward, supporting exports in the near term.

>how to get started
Purchase a corn cob pipe (or a cheap briar pipe) and a pouch of Half and Half or Captain Black tobacco from a smoke shop
or online. You will need a lighter or match, and something to tamp it with--a large nail works well if you don't have a pipe tool.
Fill the pipe with tobacco, pack it down halfway, top it off, pack it down to 3/4, top it off again, pack gently and enjoy. Smoke
slower than you think you need to, the tobacco tastes best when it is burning cool. Tamp and re-light as needed. If you still
have trouble, try different methods on YouTube until you find one that works for you.
>smoking a pipe will give you cancer
Originally the Surgeon General found that pipe and cigar smokers, following a careful study of the statistics (at a time when
most adults smoked, so they had a good sample size), had insignificant death rate increases. Nowadays, tobacco is being
legislated against while hard drugs are being legalized. Put two and two together. Tobacco is just another good thing under attack by the government.

>muh weed
Not the time or place. Start your own thread.

All tobacco users welcome.

item.title: [119] /twg/ - Taiwan General
item.description:
Quick Start Guide for First Timers:

Visa: Most countries get 90 days visa-free. Check if you need an eVisa or ARC if staying longer. Fill out your arrival card online before arriving for less stress.
Best Time: Oct–Dec for perfect weather (dry season). Avoid July–Sept typhoon season unless you like rain and chaos.
Getting Around: Taipei MRT is clean, cheap, and efficient as fuck. Youbike only needs an easy card and is essentially free unless you want to ride for hours.
High Speed Rail (HSR) for city hopping (Taipei Kaohsiung in ~1.5h).
Scooters are god outside Taipei. Get an international permit if you plan to ride.
Uber works but taxis are cheap. Avoid during rush hour or rain.

Food:

Night markets are mandatory. Shilin, Raohe, Ningxia, etc.
Must eats: Beef noodle soup, stinky tofu (acquired taste), oyster omelettes, bubble tea (original homeland), pineapple cake, mango shaved ice. All you can eat hotpot also.
7-11 and FamilyMart are better than in most countries, you can live off them if you want.

Top Spots:

Taipei: 101, Jiufen old street, Beitou hot springs, temples everywhere.
Taroko Gorge (east coast) — absolute kino nature.
Sun Moon Lake, Kenting (beaches), Alishan for mountains.
East coast for chill vibes and fewer tourists.

General Tips:

Taiwanese people are polite and helpful. Learn basic Mandarin or use Google Translate.
Tipping is not expected.

Useful Links & Services:

Official Taiwan Tourism: https://eng.taiwan.net.tw/
YouBike: https://en.youbike.com.tw/
EasyCard: Buy at MRT/7-11 — https://www.easycard.com.tw/en/
HSR: https://www.thsrc.com.tw/
Hot Springs: https://taiwanhotspring.net/ + https://eng.taiwan.net.tw/m1.aspx?sNo=0002035

item.title: [210] Real Traveler's map™ thread
item.description:
Post your travel maps in this thread. Pic related is the official /trv/ Real Traveler's map™, edition 4.0.5. I am remaking this general after almost a year of it being dead, so this is not the usual OP.

Fill in the countries and subdivisions you have visited, talk about your map and ask others about their maps. You can use the map however you like, the colors are more like suggestions, you don't have to use them, and you don't have to use all of them. You can add or remove colors and change the map as much as you want in any way you want. Don't like this map? Upload a completely different one. Up to you. Despite what some might say, there's no "wrong" way to use the map, and new posters and less travelled people are welcome and encouraged to stay and post :) This map is a group effort by our board, and we can only improve it if people reach out to share suggestions or corrections.

This is the newest edition of the map, edition 4.0.5, updated for September 2025. Thanks to an Anon in previous threads, it is now easier than ever to fill in the map. You can use the website splored.com to easily color in entire countries with a single click. At the time of making this thread, it uses the old 4.0.4 template, so you still need to update it to 4.0.5 with the simplified template, but hopefully it will be updated.
